summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the repentance assertions, majority’s quick response, continuing hope, qualified death statement, only-believed reading, absolute negation of departure from God, suffering without added willingness, and final promise concerning all of the latter group. Reader-facing “servants” and contextual repentance comply with current policy. The notes distinguish the selected readings from alternatives and editorial restorations consistently with the supplied bounded reports. Acceptance concerns source fidelity and disclosure, not authentication of unseen manuscripts, exhaustive collation, or scholarly certification.
